notes: Public Windows beta identity, installed through the signed .msixbundle and App Installer file that windows-installer.yml publishes from qualified Alpha builds (Docs/windows-installer.md). It is separate from the developer identity in package-identity.json, so both can be installed side by side; both use the same %LOCALAPPDATA%\JustSpeakToIt data directory as the portable bundle.

The name deliberately carries no maturity label: when Windows leaves beta, only the display name changes and installed copies keep updating in place. A different publisher, however, is a different package family, so the first signed publisher is a lasting choice.
There is no default publisher. The layout builder requires the exact subject of the signing certificate (WINDOWS_MSIX_PUBLISHER).

The version is derived from the release manifest's 12-digit build number (windows_installer.package_version), so every published build is strictly newer than the last across Alpha and Stable candidates.
Settings in the developer notes about write virtualisation, the startup task, maxVersionTested and processor architectures apply unchanged.
